8-second continuous live-action historical epic shot, landscape 16:9. Reference image 1 defines this SAME encampment much later, in the dark hours BEFORE DAWN. Dark charcoal sky with only a faint cool gray horizon, NO pink sunset, NO visible sun, NO bright morning. Firelight remains the primary source; numerous substantial fires are still burning among damaged tents. Keep this predawn stage throughout, no fast timelapse or sudden extinction.
LOCKED TRIPOD CAMERA. The mountain notch, dead tree, right watchtower and road keep exactly the same screen positions and scale during all eight seconds. No pan, no tracking, no dolly, no zoom, no rotation, no reframing. Do not follow people or approach them.
0-8 seconds: the existing small exhausted soldiers and one supply cart walk continuously from screen RIGHT to screen LEFT away from camp. All full bodies remain small, same scale as the reference. Front man grips shafts and pulls left; rear man pushes the rear cart rail left; wheels rotate with correct ground contact. Leading soldiers leave frame left first, followed by cart and trailing soldiers. Loose clothing, singed torn hems, dusty uneven wraps and battered asymmetrical armor remain disordered; no formal clean hats or tidy uniform outfits. No magically repaired clothing. The men stagger slightly from exhaustion but stay on their feet, no falling or support-pair close-ups.
Nearby structures are more burned and partly collapsed than the evening scene, but distant camp fires remain vigorous. Dry ash and earth; no rain or puddles. No new people, no turn back toward flames, no extra horses, no fog veil, no glossy CGI. No captions, text or fade-to-black inside the generated shot.

Audio: ONLY natural environmental and nonverbal action sound. Burning wood crackles and roars at appropriate distance; for soldiers, dry footsteps, clothes rubbing, restrained breathing and wooden wheels creaking follow actual movement. NO speech, NO narration, NO shouted words, NO singing, NO music, NO instruments, NO dramatic soundtrack or rhythmic drums. No engines or modern machinery. Do not read instructions aloud.
